items.title: LeBron James Has 'Best Game' For Sixers In Win Over Knicks
items.summary: LeBron James finished with 20 points, nine rebounds, and eight assists in the Philadelphia 76ers' 98-93 win over the New York Knicks in the NBA Cup on Friday night. "He's been good, but that was his best game for sure," Philly coach Nick Nurse said of James. Tyrese Maxey described James as a "calming presence" in late-game situations, with the Sixers winning all five of their games in clutch time. "At the end of the day, he's LeBron James," Maxey said. "So it's just like he can do stuff like he did tonight, a couple of big buckets." James also tied Kareem Abdul-Jabbar as the fifth-oldest in NBA history to score 20 points. The Sixers were without Jaylen Brown, who sat the game with a left patellar injury. James added that he was enjoying his time in Philadelphia. "I'm having a great time," James said. "... I'm a big-ass kid, to be completely honest, but these guys are great to be around, and I'm more than happy that I've made the decision to come here."

items.title: Ochai Agbaji, Thunder Agree To Contract
items.summary: Ochai Agbaji has agreed to sign with the Oklahoma City Thunder. The Thunder had an open roster spot and a major need on the wing following injuries to Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace last Sunday. Agbaji was waived by the New York Knicks at the end of preseason. In 62 games last season with the Toronto Raptors and Brooklyn Nets, Agbaji averaged 5.1 points and 2.3 rebounds in 15.7 minutes. Agbaji was the 14th overall pick in the 2022 NBA draft by the Utah Jazz.
